title: olea aquifolium var. subintegra
intro: Olea aquifolium var. subintegra, commonly known as Holly Olive, is a plant species within the Oleaceae family. It is valued for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Olea aquifolium var. subintegra include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include oleuropein, which is a compound with potential health benefits, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
